identity.name: Signed Process Performing Unpopular Injection
identity.summary: An attacker uses a legitimate signed binary to inject malicious code into a process, triggering the 'Signed process performed an unpopular injection' alert. Cortex should detect the injection behavior
identity.description: An attacker uses a legitimate signed binary to inject malicious code into a process, triggering the 'Signed process performed an unpopular injection' alert. Cortex should detect the injection behavior and the anomalous process injection pattern.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Signed Process Injection Anomaly
biocs.description: Detection of injection behavior by a signed process that is not typically used for such activity
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe' and action_process_image_name = 'svchost.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'svchost.exe' and action_file_path = '/tmp/evil.exe'
